tools.name: search
tools.description: Use when you know the topic but need authoritative pages. Searches titles, descriptions, headings and body; deduplicates chunks into pages in Fumadocs full-text relevance order (ZBSearch). Rank is a position, not confidence. Read a result with get_page; narrow query or section if has_more is true.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Use when you do not know the topic keywords. Browse page identities and URLs, optionally within a section; then get_page to read one. Pages are sorted by URL. Use offset plus limit for the next slice of this static index.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Use after search or list_pages to read the authoritative full Markdown of one page, including canonical URL and freshness metadata. This does not fetch external websites. On PAGE_NOT_FOUND, search again or browse the public index.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_pages" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List all docs pages with their pathnames (URLs)" → after: "Use when you do not know the topic keywords. Browse page identities and URLs, optionally within a section; then get_page to read one. Pages are sorted by URL. Use offset plus limit for the next slice of this static index."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
